purpose: Publish one bilingual, non-fragmented explanation of Canary RIC-eligible public debt, its relationship to RICPE and the exact proved, open and excluded Acosta Matos connections.
material_update_reason: This release integrates official public issue facts and a produced Treasury source package into the existing RIC/RICPE architecture without changing a legal allegation, proceeding status or attributed liability conclusion.
controlling_conclusion: Not zero connection and not the same money: public debt and RICPE are parallel RIC materialisation routes; the direct Acosta destination link is RICPE to HNT; no public-bond allocation to HNT is established.
non_inference_rules: Same RIC policy ecosystem does not mean the same issuer, beneficiary, project or money.
The 2024 and 2025 public issues cannot be the original source of the 2022 and 2023 HNT loans.
Dissociated subscriber data neither proves nor excludes an Acosta Matos subscriber.
Shared financial providers or infrastructure do not establish a shared transaction or responsibility.
No double funding, preferential treatment, diversion or criminality is established.
